title: Institutional governance, privacy and collaboration — agent-panel evaluation

panel_protocol.limitation: Source-verified and fixture-proven implementation only; live multi-tenant production hosting, formal external legal/privacy reviews, and cross-institutional artefact exchange trials remain gated.

consensus_summary: The expert panel reached unanimous consensus approving Track 28 (Institutional governance, privacy and collaboration). The implementation across crates/searchright-governance, crates/searchright-contracts, crates/searchright-screening, scripts/redaction.py, and documentation assets provides robust, fail-closed institutional policy evaluation, cryptographically bound lifecycle management, and independent human adjudication. Deny-by-default logic guards all sensitive operations including telemetry, external models, cross-border transfers, and non-public multi-tenant hosting. Audit ledger immutability and legal hold protections are strictly enforced. The 29 scenario integration tests in crates/searchright-governance/tests/governance_scenarios.rs, together with 29 unit tests and Python test suites, verify all error paths and authority bindings. All open gates for external institutional reviews and cross-institution pilots are faithfully preserved in evidence ledgers without unwarranted promotion.

assertions_evaluated.statement: Institutional policy and data-handling decision contracts.
assertions_evaluated.notes: Policy, request, and decision contracts verified across unit tests and integration scenarios, enforcing deny-by-default with deterministic blocker codes.

assertions_evaluated.statement: Data classification, purpose, storage and retention rules.
assertions_evaluated.notes: Classification gating, retention limits, regional restrictions, and URL/secret redaction verified across Rust and Python test suites.

assertions_evaluated.statement: Human approval and least-privilege role decisions.
assertions_evaluated.notes: Cryptographic approval binding, BoundedLifecycleApprovalRegistry temporal windows, and single-use nonces verified.

assertions_evaluated.statement: Multi-reviewer assignment, conflict and adjudication boundaries.
assertions_evaluated.notes: Reviewer role segregation, independent conflict adjudication (ScreeningError::AdjudicatorNotIndependent), and mandatory human confirmation for agent exclusions verified.

assertions_evaluated.statement: Federated artefact threat model and pilot prerequisites.
assertions_evaluated.notes: Threat model in docs/security/threat-model.md details federation risks; pilot prerequisites are documented with open gates preserved.
